|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 20 September 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “[Pilot] 2. Once during your turn, you may use 1 Force to ▲ one card that has 'Chewie' or 'Wookiee' in game text.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Chewbacca (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 3: Revolution, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. During your turn, may use 1 Force to take a card with “Chewie” or “Wookiee” in game text into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' “[Pilot] 2. Once during” → “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. During”; removed “you”; “▲ one” → “take a”; “that has 'Chewie'” → “with “Chewie””; “'Wookiee'” → ““Wookiee””; “text.” → “text into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=1 VirtualCards3.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown); page 1, slip 4. Slip image and game text from this sheet. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008193702/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards3.pdf Internet Archive primary-source copy].
